Advertisement for the post of Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
Applications are invited from the suitable candidates for the one (01) post of Junior Research
Fellow (JRF) to work on a project titled “Design and development of collapsible shipping
container ” funded by Avibindra Solutions Private Limited at UIET, Panjab University, Chandigarh.
The detailed information is given below:
Description Details
Job Title : Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
No of Posts : 01
Project Title : Design and development of collapsible shipping container
Project Duration/
Tenure of Post
: Eighteen months or position is coterminous with the duration of the
project
Nature of
Appointment
: The appointment will be purely on temporary basis and the
position is coterminous with the project. The performance of JRF will
be evaluated on a regular basis and continuation will be based on
satisfactory performance.
Sponsoring
Agency
: Avibindra Solutions Private Limited, New Delhi
Fellowship : Rs. 30,000/- per month (consolidated)
Essential
Qualification
: Master Degree/Bachelor Degree in Engineering and Technology in
Mechanical/ Electrical/ Electronics/ Computer Science/ Information
Technology or equivalent allied branch
Desirable : Some experience in Design & Fabrication of components, mechatronics and
automatic control.
Project Team : 1. Dr. Amit Thakur (Principal Investigator), Assistant Professor,
Mechanical Engineering, UIET, Panjab University, Chandigarh
2. Prof. Manu Sharma (Co-Investigator), Professor,Mechanical
Engineering, UIET, Panjab University,Chandigarh
Job
Specifications/
Responsibilities
: To perform work assigned and assist the PI and Co-PIs in various
phases of the research project.
Last Date to Apply : 12th April, 2024 (Application form can be downloaded
fromhttps://uiet.puchd.ac.in/employment and jobs
https://jobs.puchd.ac.in/list-jobs.php )
Selection Procedure
And Project
description
Shortlisted candidates will have to give a 10 min. presentation.
In the presentation, candidate is expected to share his/her
imagination/visualization regarding planning as well as
execution of the project in 18 months. Description of the
project is as below:
To design a ocean going 20 feet container made of Corten steel
which can fold/collapse to no larger than 1/3 of its original size
and internal volume when empty. Three folded containers
should occupy same size as a normal container. When unfolded
it should be the same size externally and internally to comply
with the standard 20 feet container as per ISO specifications. The
design should also be scale able and work for a 40 feet container
with the same conditions i.e. to one third its size and comply
with the ISO requirement.
• The design (s) should be unique and patentable. It should not
overlap or incorporate any features of existing folding containers
already in the market or which have been patented. To ensure
that this does not happen research should be done as to what is
already patented.
• The folding /unfolding mechanism should be electro
mechanical and not require any human intervention. The folding
process should be mechanised and should work electrically.
Once plugged in and at the press of a button, the container
should fold when empty and open up when plugged in and be
ready for use.
• The design should meet the ISO certifications for 20 feet. The
design and the proto type should be certified by certifying
agencies such as Lloyds or Bureau Veritas.
• The certifying process for a container generally involves
putting it on a specialised rig and subject it to the rigors and
pressure the container would face on the ship while at sea,
including stacking load of as per ISO Standards and water
pressures and violent movement of during rough seas.
• Once folded the three containers should have the ability to lock
into each other using a locking system such as twist locks etc.
How to Apply : Candidates should submit their application through E-mail/Speed
Post/by hand to the address given below on before the last date.
Address for Submission of Application:
Dr. Amit Thakur, Assistant Professor,
Mechnical Engineering, University Institute of Engineering and
Technology, Sector 25, South Campus, Panjab University, Chandigarh
160014
The submission of soft copy of the application is also mandatory and has
to be sent to thakur.uiet@gmail.com and copy to manu@pu.ac.in with
subject line “Application for Junior Research Fellow for collapsible
shipping container ”. The same needs to be mentioned on the envelope
also.
Only shortlisted candidates will be communicated through Email to appear in the
interview and no other communication in this regard will be entertained.
Note:
1. The applicant will be responsible for the authenticity of information, other documents
and photographs submitted.
2. The Institute reserves the right to accept applications at any time, and consider candidates of
exceptional credentials. Qualification and experience may be relaxed by the Institute at any
point of time for otherwise exceptional candidates.
3. Mere possessing the prescribed qualification does not ensure that the candidate would be
selected. The Candidate will be selected on the basis of merit, performance in interview and
need of the project.
4. Shortlisted Candidates have to present themselves for the interview on 20th April, 2024 from
11.00 am in Conference Hall, UIET, Panjab University, Chandigarh. The candidates must report
along with updated CV and original and attested photocopies of mark sheets/ certificates in
support of their academic qualifications. at least one hour before the schedule time.
5. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview.
6. Selected Candidate may also register for PhD program at UIET, Panjab University, Chandigarh
as per the Institute norms/ Rules.
(Application form can be downloaded from https://uiet.puchd.ac.in/employment
and jobs, https://jobs.puchd.ac.in/list-jobs.php )
